newsitem.title: BELGIUM: P&O Nedlloyd Container to choose alliance ties.
newsitem.headline: P&O Nedlloyd Container to choose alliance ties.

text.p: The joint venture of the container businesses of P&O Ltd and Royal Nedlloyd NV will be a member of either the Global or Grand shipping alliances, the European Commission said on Friday.
It did not say which camp P&O Nedlloyd Container Line Ltd would choose.
The Commission noted in clearing the joint venture earlier on Friday, that its parent companies currently belong to competing shipping consortia: the Global Alliance and the Grand Alliance.
The merged entity would have to choose between the two, it said, although it looked more like a logical development of the merger than a condition imposed by the EU's competition watchdog.

"It is intended that the joint venture company will be a member of only one of these consortia," it said, noting that the alliances imposed notice periods which prevent immediate withdrawal. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
